Politics · India

Nationwide Protests Over Exam Scandal Force Education Minister's Resignation

Nationwide protests, initially sparked by a digital campaign involving a cockroach analogy, have led to the resignation of Union Education Minister Dharmendra Pradhan. The protests, described as youth-led and involving a 'cockroach movement', gained momentum and put pressure on the government. Reports indicate that the government did not rule out the minister's resignation amidst the agitation. The education policy has seen four ministers and evolved over a decade under the current regime.
